content.text: You are in a dusty study.

scripts.update_options:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local opts = {}
-- Desk
if not sceneState.desk_checked then table.insert(opts, 1) end
-- Bookshelf
table.insert(opts, 2)
-- Window
table.insert(opts, 3)
-- Key
if sceneState.desk_checked and not sceneState.has_key then table.insert(opts, 4) end
-- Unlock Door
if sceneState.has_key and not sceneState.door_unlocked then table.insert(opts, 5) end
-- Leave
if sceneState.door_unlocked then table.insert(opts, 6) end
sceneState.optionsVisible = opts
scripts.move_cursor_up:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local count = #sceneState.optionsVisible
if count > 0 then
    sceneState.choiceIdx = sceneState.choiceIdx - 1
    if sceneState.choiceIdx < 1 then sceneState.choiceIdx = count end
end
scripts.move_cursor_down:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local count = #sceneState.optionsVisible
if count > 0 then
    sceneState.choiceIdx = sceneState.choiceIdx + 1
    if sceneState.choiceIdx > count then sceneState.choiceIdx = 1 end
end
scripts.handle_selection:
local sceneState = ctx.sceneState
local sel = sceneState.optionsVisible[sceneState.choiceIdx]
if sel == 1 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'You check the desk. There is a rusty key inside.'
    sceneState.desk_checked = true
elseif sel == 2 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'The books are about ancient architecture.'
elseif sel == 3 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'It is raining outside.'
elseif sel == 4 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'You take the rusty key.'
    sceneState.has_key = true
elseif sel == 5 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'You unlock the heavy oak door.'
    sceneState.door_unlocked = true
elseif sel == 6 then
    sceneState.status_text = 'You leave the room.'
    sceneState.state = 'left'
end
sceneState.choiceIdx = 1
local opts = {}
if not sceneState.desk_checked then table.insert(opts, 1) end
table.insert(opts, 2)
table.insert(opts, 3)
if sceneState.desk_checked and not sceneState.has_key then table.insert(opts, 4) end
if sceneState.has_key and not sceneState.door_unlocked then table.insert(opts, 5) end
if sceneState.door_unlocked then table.insert(opts, 6) end
sceneState.optionsVisible = opts
